svg.title: Restore configuration links, then verify they are current
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal session on an existing Arch Linux desktop with the desktop profile selected and the repository up to date. The user types dotfiles install --only symlinks to restore two missing Git and Zsh configuration links. Home symlinks is one changed task, taking 0.8 seconds. Running the same command again reports one current task in 0.2 seconds. Output appears on a fixed terminal grid; the live status is replaced in place and the shell prompt returns after each run. The 20-second loop holds the completed session for reading. Reduced motion displays the completed transcript without blinking.
